## User and outcome

Who needs this behavior? Give a request, an observable response and a failure case.

## Owner and boundaries

Which module owns the decision and its data? Name the existing public contracts it needs. Describe any event or HTTP compatibility implications.

## Proof

Identify the nearest existing slice and the test you would run. Include a concurrency, retry or access-control case where the behavior depends on one.
